summary: Chamber rename feature tested (backend pytest 7/7 + mobile 390x844 UI as client admin, operator, superadmin). Backend rename/reset/whitespace collapse/404/422/401/403 RBAC and cross-client isolation all correct; event log entry present. UI: pencil, input, Enter/save/Escape, toast, header/tabs/Settings/Data history title update, empty → 'Komora N', operator has no pencil, 30-char name truncates with ellipsis, no horizontal overflow. ONE real bug: while the rename input is open, the 5s device poll resets the typed value (typed text lost).

minor.issue: No-op rename (same/default name) still writes an event log entry, e.g. 'zmieniono nazwę „Komora 6” → „Komora 6”'. Skip log_event (and DB write/load_registry) when old == new.

ui_bugs.issue: useEffect(() => setVal(...), [dev, id, edit]) runs every 5s because App.loadDevices creates a new dev object each poll. Typed text in chamber-<id>-name-input is wiped back to the stored name (reproduced: typed 'Poro', waited 6.5s, input value became ''). Users who type slowly lose input / save wrong value. Fix: only init val when edit turns true, e.g. deps [edit, id] or set val in the pencil onClick.

issues: Pencil button shrinks to ~22px width with 30-char name (flex-shrink); add flexShrink:0 to the pencil button.

action_items: Fix ChamberNameEdit useEffect so the 5s device poll doesn't reset the input while editing (deps [edit, id] only, or init on pencil click)
Skip event log / DB write when the chamber name is unchanged
Add flexShrink:0 to the rename pencil button
critical_code_review_comments: ChamberNameEdit: useEffect depends on the dev object reference, which changes every poll (that's the HIGH bug).
rename_chamber calls load_registry() (reloads all clients/devices/thresholds) for one field change; updating DEVICES[device_id]['chamber_names'] in memory would be cheaper.
Pydantic max_length=30 is checked before whitespace collapse, so 31+ chars with padding spaces are rejected even if trimmed length <=30 (fine since frontend trims; just noting).

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (1 HIGH bug: input reset by poll)

seed_data_creation: Temporary users ui_admin_it18/ui_operator_it18@example.com + pytest test_* users were created and deleted. All chamber_names reset to {} on kowalski-a and chlodnia-01.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: click welcome-login-button on / first, then login-email/password/submit. Superadmin switches device via select[data-testid=device-select] (label 'Ferma Kowalski · Tuczarnia A'). To retest the bug: open chamber-0-rename, type text, wait 6s, check chamber-0-name-input value is preserved. Clean up with PUT name '' for all chambers.
rca of the issue: App.js polls /api/devices every 5s → setDevices(new array) → dev prop is new object → ChamberNameEdit useEffect [dev,id,edit] fires → setVal(dev.chamber_names[id] || '') overwrites user's in-progress text. Repro: open rename, type, wait >5s. Mitigation: depend on [edit, id] only.
